title: Mātṛkā install curriculum — 10 gated stages
rule: ASSEMBLY of attested parts. Order, timings and graduation bars are modern apparatus; every practice element traces to MV / TĀ / PTv / VBT. No stage may present synthesis as doctrine (AGENTS.md lock 9).
menu_root: Trika (lab menu is Trika-only; other tracks parked)

stages.title: Full body chant
stages.nightly: 1 × full round aloud with touch + glyph, gap 4–15s, ~15 min
stages.goal: Install all 50 in order; body filled as a field
stages.graduation: Follow the round without losing place; replay works without refresh

stages.title: Vowel powers (PTv nights)
stages.nightly: guided night (intro + directed rounds + open loop), ~15 min
stages.goal: Each vowel = power + locus, not just sound (a=cit … aḥ=visarga)
stages.graduation: Name all 16 powers with loci from memory; Nights 4–5 held in silence without substituting sound

stages.title: Varga isolation
stages.nightly: 1 varga × 5 slow rounds, touch the limb arc, ~10 min
stages.goal: One limb as a single arc (ka right arm, ca left arm, ṭa/ta legs, pa torso)
stages.graduation: Chant a varga feeling its limb arc without looking at the body

stages.title: Recall both directions
stages.nightly: quiz to 20 answers or 10 min, weakest-first
stages.goal: Sound↔locus fires without the chart (smṛti as install)

stages.title: Reverse pass (saṃhāra)
stages.menu: Phase 1 chant dock → series full 50 reversed
stages.nightly: 1 × kṣa→a round, slower than install, ~10 min
stages.goal: Withdrawal direction: body-field empties back toward anuttara
stages.graduation: Smooth reverse round; felt emptying, not just backwards sounds

stages.title: Aṅga rapid install
stages.goal: Full install in under a minute: heart/head/shoulders/eyes/hands
stages.graduation: Correct formulas at correct loci from memory, <60s
attested: TĀ 15 aṅga formulas (heart aṅ kaṁ… etc.)
assembly: prompter score (practitioner voices; no recordings exist)

stages.title: Mantra trajectories
stages.menu: Matrika course → Phases 4–5 (AUM, SO'HAM, OM, OM NAMAH SHIVAYA)
stages.goal: Installed body moves as mantra; light locked to recorded sound
stages.graduation: Run AUM + SO'HAM + OM + namaḥ śivāya from memory, in time
attested: OM 11-stage spine + amṛta down-flood (Padoux 422–425, Netra sequel)

stages.title: OM ascent + nectar descent
stages.nightly: OM loop, ride each station heart→dvādaśānta, feel the rain back
stages.goal: Two-way shape: ascent then suffusion (sṛṣṭi + saṃhāra in one session)
stages.graduation: Ascent and down-flood both vivid without the readout

stages.title: Mālinī rewrite
stages.menu: Malini order → Phase 1 (chant full, cfg malini)
stages.goal: Second sky: same 50, goddess order, own geometry (never relabeled Mātṛkā dots)
stages.graduation: Stable Mālinī round; Mātṛkā loci do not intrude
attested: Mālinī = real second config at madhyamā (Padoux 341–342)

stages.title: Gaze + internalization (VBT)
stages.nightly: timed gaze score, then silent sit
stages.goal: Fixed gaze with body-wide attention; supports internalize the install (madhyamā)
stages.graduation: Sustained gaze + body-field present without prompts; vaikhari→madhyamā ascent available on demand
attested: VBT dhāraṇā (selected; Lakshmanjoo lineage reference on volume)

rules: One tradition per sitting; never mix rites (Rauravāgama via Flood).
Natural breath always (TĀ 4.91); stop always available.
Mālinī only after Mātṛkā automatic; śabdarāśi third nyāsa is a later layer, not in this v1.
Graduation bars are apparatus; the real criterion throughout is anusamdhāna (identity-attention), not counts.
